sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case with a view to cause unnecessary harassment and to victimize him.
There are several transcriptions of the conversation between the parties, which indicate otherwise and does not support the prosecution story.
Learned counsel has further stated that the ingredients of Section 304-B IPC are not fulfilled.
As such, the demand of dowry is not fulfilled.

It is further stated that the co-accused Meena Devi has already been enlarged on bail by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 22.9.2020 passed in CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 25860 of 2020.

entities.text: CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 25860 of 2020
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
It is further stated that there is no criminal history of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 14.1.2020 for no fault of his own.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

7. Per contra, learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the first informant have has vehemently opposed the bail application on the ground that the death of the deceased person has been caused within the period of about two months and a young girl has been put to death for no fault of her own.
The applicant is not co-operating in trial and even the charge could not be framed.

8. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties, nature of offence, evidence on record, pending trial and taking into consideration that even the charge is yet not framed, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
9. The bail application is, accordingly, rejected.

10. However, it is directed that the court below may proceed with the trial and reach at the logical conclusion expeditiously, if there is no legal impediment, within a period of one year from the date of production of a certified copy of this order.

11. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
